title: k11 Appium QA MCP Server
description:
MCP server and CI tool for self-healing Appium locators in native and hybrid Android and iOS apps: heals broken locators against the screen each test failed on, rewrites Python and Java Page Objects including AndroidFindBy and iOSXCUITFindBy annotations, verifies every change by re-running on the device, flags accessibility issues, and writes an audit report that k11 Release Gate reads as evidence.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-appium-qa-mcp
